ORDER This Writ Petition has been filed in the nature of mandamus, seeking a direction against the first respondent to take appropriate action against the third respondent, who, according to the petitioner is facing allegation of misappropriation of funds of the Panchayat.
The petitioner place reliance on Sections 203, 205 of Tamil Nadu Panchayat Act, 1994.
2.It is stated that the third respondent is an accused in Crime No. 82 of 2021, registered under Sections 409, 420 of IPC by the Thattarmadam Police Station on 12.05.2021.
3.It is trite law to point out that merely indicating the name in a FIR does not indicate that the said person is a convicted accused.
The FIR is registered on information.

Thereafter, investigation will have to be conducted on the nature of allegation in the report and on satisfaction, a final report https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis would have to be filed before the jurisdictional Magistrate.
The concerned Magistrate will have to take cognizance of the same.
Thereafter, the Magistrate will have to take a decision either to frame charges or to discharge the accused.
Only thereafter shall trial proceedings commence.
The presumption of innocence runs till conviction.
4.At this stage no direction is given, since only FIR is pending against the third respondent.
Accordingly, this writ petition stands dismissed.
No costs.
